relationship: One grouped distribution is represented by histogram bar areas and cumulative-frequency growth, so changing an interval affects both displays and quartile read-offs.

learnerLoop.action: Set bar heights, construct cumulative totals, operate a linked read-off ruler and compare recorded distributions.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Frequency equals interval width times density. Cumulative growth integrates the same bar areas; quartile ranks use the same total. The learner's cumulative sketch remains a separately identified prediction until checked.
learnerLoop.evidence: Equal-height unequal-width bars expose the area misconception. A checked cumulative sketch is overlaid with the report line; the ruler links area to rank, and an incorrect range draws a bracket that misses Q3.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Revise an area rather than hunt for a green height, include all preceding groups, locate a quartile rank or compare the effect of changing a group.

invariants: Histogram area represents frequency even when class widths differ.
Cumulative frequency never decreases and ends at the total frequency.
safeAdaptations: Vary valid grouped intervals and frequencies while retaining linked displays.
Change working support without disconnecting quartile evidence from the cumulative curve.
nonGoals: Using bar height alone as frequency for unequal-width classes.

actions.description: One persistent primary action; Back and optional previously-visited Forward are secondary. Model-specific callbacks and gates are unchanged.
actions.visibility: Same relative position below the apparatus and working; before saved readings.

help.description: Learner-requested evidence cue, relationship hint and contrasting worked example; no automatic answer-directed pulse.
help.visibility: Only when requested in the relevant experience.

reset.description: Native disclosure with ordered actions and scope descriptions; full restart uses an inline confirmation. Cancel, Escape, outside click and tab-away preserve the current model.
reset.visibility: Disclosure always available; reset actions disabled during model transitions. Confirmation is never opened automatically.

prompt.description: A short goal and action sentence above the apparatus, with a guided-step label and quiet restart disclosure.

model.description: Frequency equals interval width times density. Cumulative growth integrates the same bar areas; quartile ranks use the same total. The learner's cumulative sketch remains a separately identified prediction until checked.
model.visibility: Always visible; later controls are progressively disclosed.

comparison.description: Frozen readings and explicitly labelled comparison conditions; graphical overlays use the selected saved reading.

navigation.description: Back and Forward restore snapshots; Repeat resets the current experience; Confirmed restart clears the session.
navigation.visibility: Back and Forward depend on visited progress.

working.description: Worked examples precede learner calculations. Explicit quantity keys connect source labels to formula operands, with matching highlights and a button-triggered trace. Hover, focus and tap explain each source and calculation.

evidence.description: Equal-height unequal-width bars expose the area misconception. A checked cumulative sketch is overlaid with the report line; the ruler links area to rank, and an incorrect range draws a bracket that misses Q3.
evidence.visibility: In-place feedback; readings only in relevant steps.

completion.description: The persistent dock button runs the current test/check and changes to Continue only after the original model-derived criterion. Feedback and help share this dock; presentation does not set completion.
completion.visibility: Guided steps; absent in the open experiment.

frequency-density.description: Frequency divided by positive class width; actual bar area is the frequency.
frequency-density.domain: Density 0–3 pupils/min; frequency moves in whole pupils. Widths are fixed positive intervals.
frequency-density.source: Bar-top handles or a tap in the bar's plot column.
frequency-density.output: The same frequency drives filled area, cumulative totals and quartile ranks.

cumulative-frequency.description: Running total through each upper class boundary.
cumulative-frequency.domain: The guided report contains 60 pupils; the editable sketch is non-decreasing with fixed endpoints 0 and 60.
cumulative-frequency.source: Three independently editable crosses; tapping a cross column and keyboard adjustment use the same setters.
cumulative-frequency.output: Dashed learner sketch and, only after checking, the solid report line.

quartiles.description: The 25%, 50% and 75% ranks of the same grouped distribution, read on both plots.
quartiles.domain: Journey time 0–60 min; ruler increments 0.5 min. Accepted read-offs are within 0.55 pupils of the target rank.
quartiles.source: The learner moves or taps the ruler and explicitly records each estimate.
quartiles.output: Actual learner read-offs persist in working; they are not silently replaced with exact model answers.

interquartile-range.description: Difference between the learner's recorded Q3 and Q1 estimates.
interquartile-range.domain: Finite numeric or fractional minutes; tolerance 0.11 min around the difference of recorded estimates.
interquartile-range.source: A structured number entry after all three read-offs.
interquartile-range.output: A tested bracket starts at Q1 and ends at Q1 plus the entered range.

modes.guided: Small ordered visual investigations, with model actions and in-place revision.
modes.experiment: Ungated experiment: alter any bar, inspect the cumulative and median consequences, save up to six frozen reports and select a comparison. Zero frequency across all intervals is valid and has undefined quartiles.

dependencies: Change the second equal-width bar from frequency 10 to 20, then check both areas. The reference stays at 10.
Keep a 10-minute interval at frequency 20; reduce a 20-minute interval from frequency 40 to 20 and explicitly check. Equal heights initially imply unequal areas.
Construct frequencies 10, 20, 20 and 10 across widths 10, 10, 20 and 20 in any order, then check all bars. Matching the total alone is insufficient.
Build cumulative totals 0, 10, 30, 50 and 60 with three movable internal points, then check against the report. The sketch remains monotone even during revision.
Record Q1, median and Q3 using the linked ruler, then enter and check the range between the recorded outer quartiles. Moving a recorded read-off clears that reading and invalidates the range verdict.

Ungated experiment: alter any bar, inspect the cumulative and median consequences, save up to six frozen reports and select a comparison. Zero frequency across all intervals is valid and has undefined quartiles.
implementation.completion: New experiences require their model-derived criterion. Back and Forward revisit saved state without forcing a rerun; Repeat experience resets only that experience. Confirmed restart clears all session snapshots. Worked observations are not mastery claims.
limitations: A deliberately fixed, synthetic report; these are not empirical pupil measurements. No random case generator is implemented.

The original contract's bar-area and non-decreasing cumulative invariants are retained. The cumulative representation uses straight joins instead of the original smooth interpolation: constant within-class density makes partial bar area and cumulative growth agree everywhere.
The graphical cells encode five pupils of area. They do not identify individual observations or assert uniform individual journey times.
Quantiles inside grouped intervals are estimates. Empty distributions have undefined quartiles. At a plateau, the model uses the first time that reaches the rank.
Guided bars and cumulative sketches are checked only on the explicit action. Manipulation remains responsive; editing clears stale checks.

Experiment records are immutable copies, capped at six. Current and saved plots share the same axis scale without normalising counts. Repeat preserves other visited steps; restart requires explicit confirmation and clears only this lab's session.
